implementation.scope: Shared live-vtable destructor range loop with four exact object strides and call return addresses.

validation.tested_scope: Four entries: empty and two-object ranges, null-address skip. Live vtable change between calls, aligned dynamic target, call order and parameters, selected full GPR/CR/XER/SP/LR, ordinary RAM and dynamic boundary events.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Destructor callee internals, invalid or unaligned ranges, faults, MMIO, concurrency and runtime.
